command: PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -c 'import json, statistics; from math import sqrt; from battleship.benchmark import run; r = run(100, 1); h, p = r["hunt"]["shots"], r["probability"]["shots"]; s = [a - b for a, b in zip(h, p)]; n = len(s); m = statistics.fmean(s); se = statistics.stdev(s) / sqrt(n); print(json.dumps({"fleets": n, "probability_fewer": sum(x > 0 for x in s), "ties": sum(x == 0 for x in s), "hunt_fewer": sum(x < 0 for x in s), "mean_shots_saved": m, "stdev_of_difference": statistics.stdev(s), "ci95_t_99df": [m - 1.9842 * se, m + 1.9842 * se], "ci95_normal": [m - 1.96 * se, m + 1.96 * se]}))'
interval_method: paired per-fleet difference (hunt minus probability); t interval with 99 df, normal interval also given
